(SELECT 1 FROM chapters c WHERE c.subject_offering_id=cs.offering_id AND c.title=cs.chapter_title) RETURNING id,subject_offering_id,title), chapter_targets AS (SELECT c.id,c.subject_offering_id,c.title FROM chapters c JOIN chapter_specs cs ON cs.offering_id=c.subject_offering_id AND cs.chapter_title=c.title UNION ALL SELECT id,subject_offering_id,title FROM inserted_chapters), inserted_lessons AS (INSERT INTO lessons(chapter_id,title,content,description,display_order,is_active,is_test_data) SELECT ct.id,n.lesson_title,NULL,NULL,n.lesson_order,false,false FROM normalized n JOIN chapter_targets ct ON ct.subject_offering_id=n.offering_id AND ct.title=n.chapter_title WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lessons le WHERE le.chapter_id=ct.id AND le.title=n.lesson_title) RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted_chapters) AS chapters_inserted,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inserted_lessons) AS lessons_inserted;
